title: WDP Server
description: A survival server built different. Custom RPG skills, auto base protection, 250 progress-driven quests, No pay-to-win. No bloat. Just a tight, handcrafted experience
body:
# WDP Server ### Survival. Evolved. **`play.wdpserver.com`** — All versions welcome. [🌐 Website](https://wdpserver.com)  ·  [💬 Discord](https://discord.gg/A2vfymZwBE)  ·  [🐛 GitHub](https://github.com/WDP-Server) --- *Custom plugins. Real RPG progression. A server built different.*
---
## What makes WDP different?
No cookie-cutter plugins. No pay-to-win. Just a tight, custom-built experience made from the ground up, base protection that *thinks*, quests that scale with the server, and skills that actually change how you play. Every system on WDP talks to each other. Your progress score updates from your gear, your kills, your economy, your advancements. All at once. Quests unlock based on where *YOU* are at, so progress stays fun with rewarding quests, both at the start and later. It's not just survival, it's a custom journey. New player? You won't be lost. A guided tutorial walks you through everything on your first join, hands you starter coins, and gets you into the action fast. Veteran? There's a 1–100 progress score, 250 quests and six skill trees. There's always something left to do. ---
## The Features
- **Auto Base Protection** Your base is detected and protected automatically — no claiming, no hassle. The system watches what you build, learns where you live, and locks it down. Trust friends, set your home, done. - **Real RPG Skills** Six skill trees — Mining, Combat, Farming, Foraging, Fishing, Enchanting. Level them up and permanently change your stats. Active abilities, passive perks, the whole deal. - **250 Quests** Five tiers of quests that unlock as you progresses though the game. You advance, your quests do to! - **Progress Score** A 1–100 score tracking your true advancement across gear, XP, economy, advancements, stats, and achievements. Reach Master if you dare. - **AI Help** (BETA) Type `/help` and ask anything. The AI knows the server inside and out — commands, quests, mechanics, all of it. ---
